newsitem.title: USA: Brown Group Famous Footwear Sept sales off.
newsitem.headline: Brown Group Famous Footwear Sept sales off.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Thursday that same store sales in September for its Famous Footwear division dropped 2.6 percent.
Sales for Famous Footwear in September were $72,800,000, an increase of two percent.
Brown Group said its Naturalizer retail division's same store sales for September rose 8.7 percent. Sales for the division increased 7.2 percent to $13.3 million.

"Famous Footwear's September same store sales results reflect a one week shorter back-to-school selling period and the reporting of the Labor Day holiday results in August this year compared to September last year, when Labor Day was a week later," Harry Rich, chief financial officer, said in a statement. "These sales results were in line with our plans."

After the Labor Day selling period, the company reported positive same store sales for the latter part of the month, although sales of fall fashion footwear were not as strong as the early back-to-school sales of athletic products in August, he added.
